error_responses: 401 'Token mancante' if no Authorization or wrong scheme
401 'Utente non trovato' if user id absent in db
auth_surface.propagation_to_subrouters: server.py passes get_current_user as parameter to register_*_routes factories (economy, etc.)

why_new_post_auth_not_ready: server_profiles router (routes/server_profiles.py) is constructed at import time without auth dependency injected
the file declares prefix '/api/server-profiles' but the select handler does NOT include Depends(get_current_user)
503 flag-gating short-circuits the request before any auth check would run
adding auth dependency before flag flip is mandatory; otherwise an unauthenticated client could be served the future preview envelope

exact_auth_requirement_for_preview.reason: preview content is user-specific (legacy users.server, future profile_id); MUST NOT leak across users
exact_auth_requirement_for_preview.audience_isolation: server returns only data for current_user

exact_auth_requirement_for_select.reason: mutation must be auth-bound; orphan/spoofing prevention

spoofing_prevention: never trust user_id from request body
derive identity exclusively from JWT via get_current_user
refuse mismatch between body server_profile_id ownership and current_user.id
telemetry: log auth failures + suspicious mismatches

gaps_identified.gap: no ownership check between server_profile_id and current_user.id
no rate-limit per user on preview/select endpoints
no audit log on auth failures for server_profiles endpoints
